subject: POC environment options & runbook outline for Skyward Health trial
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@skywardhealth.com>, Alyssa Cheng <alyssa.cheng@skywardhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: trial goals, environment options, and next steps

Hi Samir / Alyssa — thanks again for taking time today. Quick written recap from our discovery call so we have shared expectations before we kick off the Proof of Concept (POC).

Key goals you stated on the call:
- Validate generation latency and throughput for 200 concurrent users across a 256-token average request
- Evaluate embedding accuracy against your existing semantic search for clinical notes
- Confirm security posture for PHI-adjacent data and export controls

Environment options we discussed (pros/cons):
1) Hosted Redwood sandbox (fastest): Redwood-managed, quick onboarding, demo data or hashed samples; good for feature validation but limited for network-isolated tests.
2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity): predictable throughput and dedicated GPUs; recommended for sustained load and latency SLO stress tests.
3) VPC trial (private): deploys our control plane with customer network peering or on-prem connector; required if you need private ingestion of sensitive records and KMS integration.

Initial recommendation: start with a 2-week hosted sandbox for functional and embedding accuracy checks, then run a 1-week dedicated sandbox burst to reproduce peak-latency scenarios. If network/isolation constraints remain, move to a VPC trial for final regulatory sign-off.

Success criteria (proposed):
- P95 token latency <= 420ms on dedicated sandbox (baseline target)
- Embedding cosine similarity improvement >= 12% vs current model on sampled queries
- No high/critical security findings in the questionnaire + signed network diagram for VPC (if applicable)

Owners / roles:
- Skyward: Samir (product owner), Alyssa (security lead)
- Redwood: Marissa (AM / program lead), Karthik (infrastructure & perf lead), Monica (customer reliability / onboarding)

Next steps (owners + timing):
- I (Marissa) will send a filled runbook template and network-requirements doc by EOD today. (Attachment: POC-Runbook-template.xlsx, network-requirements-skyward.pdf)
- Samir to confirm dataset size and whether you can share a hashed sample for embedding evaluation by Fri 6/12.
- Karthik will follow up with a proposed config for the dedicated sandbox and estimated cost by Mon 6/14.

If that all looks right, we can schedule the kickoff for Tue 6/15. Open to adjustments.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: POC-Runbook-template.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)]
[Attachment: network-requirements-skyward.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@skywardhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa.cheng@skywardhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: trial goals, environment options, and next steps

Marissa — appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Dataset: we can provide a 10k-record anonymized/hash sample of clinical notes by Friday 6/12. That should be sufficient for the embedding A/B tests.
2) Security: we will need to see a network diagram before approving any VPC work. Alyssa will own that sign-off.
3) Timeline: tight on calendar the week of 6/21, so if we can start onboarding the hosted sandbox on 6/15 that helps.

Two questions for your infra lead: how much time should we budget for the dedicated sandbox cold-start versus hosted? Also please include an estimate for tokens used for the 2-week hosted smoke tests.

Samir
Product Lead, Search & Insights
Skyward Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@skywardhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 07:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: trial goals, environment options, and next steps

Hi Samir / Marissa — quick technical notes and an initial sizing estimate: we recommend the following for your test plan: 

- Hosted sandbox (2 weeks): Best for functional checks and embedding accuracy. No network peering required. Provisioning time: <24 hours. Expected tokens for smoke + embedding runs: ~1.2M tokens.
- Dedicated sandbox burst (5 GPUs, A10x or similar equivalent): Provisioning time: 48-72 hours for reserved capacity; we can accelerate if you sign a short reserved window. This environment will let us run concurrency tests to capture P95/P99 behavior. Estimated tokens during the 1-week stress window: ~5M tokens.
- VPC trial: Requires network diagram + firewall ACLs + KMS details. Plan 2-3 weeks for setup if you need customer peering and HSM/KMS integration.

Cost note (very rough): hosted smoke run ~$400, dedicated 5-GPU burst ~$3,500 for the week (estimate, subject to finalize). We'll include exact pricing in the formal quote.

Action items from Redwood infra:
- I'll draft the dedicated sandbox config and upload it to the shared Drive by EOD today (link to follow).
- Monica will own onboarding docs and will coordinate user access and logs.

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample-sla-matrix.docx (Word, 26KB)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@skywardhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Alyssa Cheng <alyssa.cheng@skywardhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: trial goals, environment options, and next steps

Thanks Samir — great, appreciate the dataset commitment. Final checklist and proposed kickoff cadence: 

1) Today (Mon 6/14): Marissa -> share completed runbook and Drive folder; Karthik -> dedicated sandbox config draft; Monica -> onboarding checklist.
2) By EOD Fri 6/18: Skyward to share hashed sample and completion of our short security questionnaire (Alyssa).
3) Kickoff hosted sandbox onboarding Tue 6/22 (since you noted calendar constraints the week of 6/21). If everything passes the hosted smoke, we aim to schedule the dedicated sandbox burst for the week of 6/29.

Owners and acceptance gates:
- Hosted pass = embedding quality checklist + no blocking security items (owner: Marissa + Alyssa)
- Dedicated pass = performance targets (owner: Karthik + Samir)
- VPC decision = only if Alyssa requires network isolation after hosted/dedicated tests (owner: Alyssa + Marissa)

Please reply all to confirm the dates or propose alternatives. Once we have confirmation I'll circulate a calendar invite and the signed runbook template.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
